summary: Public Storage Operating Company, guaranteed by Public Storage, filed a 424B5 pricing a $500 million offering of 5.600% senior unsecured notes due November 15, 2036. Notes priced at 98.293% of par for $491.465 million gross, a 0.450% underwriting discount ($2.25 million), and $489.215 million net proceeds before expenses. Interest is semi-annual beginning May 15, 2027; settlement is expected November 6, 2026. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, callable, unlisted, and structurally subordinated to subsidiary debt. Joint bookrunners include BofA Securities, BNP Paribas, and Morgan Stanley. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and rate sensitivity.
